text:
tara: Quick follow-up from UX review: the 'See docs' link at the bottom of the model settings panel is not discoverable. Users expect the help link next to the setting label. Can we make it inline?

ali: Agree. Also noticed we use 'Model variant' in some places and 'Model version' in others. We should map terminology across console, in-product panels, and docs.

docs-bot: I opened an issue in docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/210 to track terminology sync. I can add a NOTE at the top of model docs explaining the mapping if we need quick fix.

peter: Implementation detail: moving the link inline will require small CSS changes to the setting row. Need to ensure it doesn't break responsive layout on mobile. Also add focus styles for keyboard users.

maria: Copy proposal: link text should be 'Model variant docs' not just 'Docs' or 'Learn more'. Makes it clearer for screen reader users too.

tara: Thanks. Can we also include a short tooltip: "Model variant: runtime label for compatible model builds"? Keep tooltip optional and hidden from screen readers (use aria-hidden) since we rely on aria-label for accessibility.

docs-bot: Holding PR until we lock final copy. Will coordinate with product and design.

tara: Ok I'll update the Figma frames and post in #design. We want to ship this with the next patch release.

ali: One more thing: ensure the cross-link opens in a new tab and analytics distinguish inline-vs-footer as requested.

notes: action items assigned to docs-bot, peter, tara.
